overall_notes: Strong visual style consistency with authentic 16mm Ektachrome look, but critical lighting and continuity issues require revision

findings.description: Major lighting inconsistency - s01-sh01 shows golden sunset light, but s01-sh02 through s02-sh01 appear to be filmed in midday/cooler light despite being a continuous sequence. The warm golden hour lighting from the establishing shot is lost.
findings.recommendation: Color grade shots s01-sh02 through s02-sh01 to match the warm golden hour lighting established in s01-sh01, or reshoot with consistent lighting

findings.description: Character appearance inconsistency - the rider's goggles position changes between shots without motivation. In s01-sh02 goggles are over eyes, in s01-sh05 they're pushed up on forehead
findings.recommendation: Add transitional moment showing character adjusting goggles or maintain consistent goggle position

findings.description: Aspect ratio inconsistency - s01-sh01 appears to be 4:3 with film edge bleed while s01-sh02 and s01-sh03 show anamorphic 2.39:1 formatting
findings.recommendation: Standardize aspect ratio across all shots - either maintain 2.39:1 anamorphic throughout or adjust opening shot

findings.description: Motion blur in mid-frame creates slight AI generation artifacts around the motorcycle subject
findings.recommendation: Consider subtle stabilization or replacement of problematic frames

shot_grades.notes: Excellent establishing shot with perfect 16mm Ektachrome aesthetic and beautiful golden hour lighting. Aspect ratio needs standardization.
Good tracking shot but lighting doesn't match established golden hour mood. Character and motorcycle details are well-rendered.
Excellent detail work on hands and handlebars. Film grain and color grading authentic. Lighting somewhat inconsistent with sequence.
Dynamic low angle shot with good motion blur effects. Some AI artifacts visible in motion frames. Lighting closer to sequence opener.
Strong character close-up with good detail and weathering. Goggle continuity issue and lighting inconsistent with golden hour mood.
Well-composed medium shot with good character positioning. Lighting continues to be inconsistent with opening sequence mood.
